employees.title: Employees
employees.hint: Everyone who works for the business, with their pay, leave and attendance.
employees.search: Search by name, number or phone
employees.emptyHint: Add your first employee to start recording attendance, leave and pay.

employee.noHint: Leave empty and one is generated.
employee.idsHint: Numbers the business reports to the authorities. Rule names come from your payroll setup.
employee.nationalIdKeep: Currently {{masked}}. Leave empty to keep it.
employee.residencyHint: Some rules apply differently to non-residents.
employee.userHint: Links this person to a system or till user.
employee.registrationsHint: The employee's number under a rule, for example a pension or insurance membership. Use the rule's code.
employee.exemptHint: Tick the rules that do not apply to this person.
employee.terminateAsk: {{name}} will be marked as having left. Pay for the final period is prorated.

pay.termsHint: Basic pay from a date. A change is proposed by one person and approved by another.
pay.proposed: Proposed. Someone else must approve it before payroll uses it.
pay.proposeInfo: Payroll uses this only after a different person approves it.
pay.noTermsHint: Propose basic pay so this employee can be included in payroll.
pay.rejectTermsAsk: Reject the proposed {{amount}} basic pay for {{name}} from {{date}}?
pay.items: Allowances, deductions and other pay items
pay.itemsHint: Recurring or one-off items added to or taken from pay.
pay.noItemsHint: Add an allowance, deduction or benefit when this person has one.
pay.noComponents: There are no pay components yet. Create one first.
pay.lastDayHint: The item stops after this date.

bank.title: Payment details
bank.hint: Where the salary is paid. A new account is proposed by one person and approved by another.
bank.proposeInfo: Payroll pays to these details only after a different person approves them.
bank.emptyHint: Propose a bank account or mobile money number.
bank.name: Bank name
bank.rejectAsk: Reject the proposed payment details {{account}} for {{name}}?

component.title: Pay components
component.intro: The named kinds of pay item you can put on an employee: allowances, deductions, benefits in kind and employer extras. Taxes and contributions are set up as rules instead.
component.emptyHint: Add the allowances and deductions your business uses.
component.codeHint: Capital letters and digits, up to 20.
component.name: Name

kindHint.deduction: Taken from the employee's pay, for example a loan repayment.
kindHint.benefit: Non-cash benefit: added to taxable pay but not paid out.
kindHint.employer_contribution: A cost to the employer that is not taken from the employee.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.hint: Who worked when. Till opens and closes clock cashiers in and out automatically; add or correct the rest by hand.
attendance.hoursHint: Worked out from the clock times if left empty.
attendance.overtimeHint: Worked out from the shift if left empty.
attendance.shiftHint: Overtime is the time beyond the shift.
attendance.emptyHint: Record the days this person worked.
attendance.emptyRangeHint: Pick another date range, or record attendance.
attendance.emptySummaryHint: Record attendance, or clock cashiers in at the till.

shift.title: Shifts
shift.name: Name
shift.endHint: A shift may end after midnight.
shift.emptyHint: Define the working hours so overtime can be worked out.

leave.title: Leave
leave.hint: Requests are decided by someone other than the person asking. Approved unpaid leave reduces pay.
leave.employeeHint: Leave empty to ask for yourself.
leave.needTypes: Add a leave type first (Leave types tab).
leave.daysHint: Leave empty to count the working days. Use 0.5 for a half day.
leave.noteHint: Shown to the employee with the decision.
leave.noRequestsHint: Requests appear here when someone asks for leave.
leave.nonePendingHint: New requests will show up here.
leave.noBalancesHint: Add leave types to see balances.
leave.overviewEmpty: Nobody is on leave this month.
leave.overviewEmptyHint: Approved and pending requests are shown here by day.
leave.noTypesHint: Add the kinds of leave your business gives, such as annual or sick leave.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.hint: One run per pay period: calculate, review, approve, post to the books and pay.
payroll.emptyHint: Start a run for the first pay period.

run.newInfo: A run covers one period of at most 31 days. Employees with approved basic pay are included.
run.created: Payroll run created. Calculate it next.
run.heading: Payroll {{start}} to {{end}}
run.submitAsk: Send this run for approval? {{count}} employees, net pay {{net}}.
run.approveAsk: Approve this run and post it to the books? {{count}} employees, net pay {{net}}. The figures are recalculated first and must match what was reviewed.
run.ownRun: You prepared this run, so someone else must approve it.
run.rejectAsk: The preparer will see your reason and can recalculate.
run.cancelAsk: Cancel this run? An approved run cannot be cancelled, but this one has not been approved.
run.payAsk: Record that {{count}} employees were paid, net pay {{net}}? Finance moves the money out of the bank, mobile money or cash.
run.notPostedNote: Approved. It is not posted to the books because Finance is not enabled.
run.reviewHint: Check these before submitting or approving. Blockers must be fixed; the rest are for your judgement.
run.notCalculatedHint: Calculate the run to work out every payslip and list what needs a look.
run.nothingToReviewHint: No new joiners, leavers, pay changes or unusual amounts this period.
run.noPayslipsHint: Nobody has approved basic pay in this period.

payslip.findHint: Payslips for other periods are in each payroll run:

taxCard.title: Yearly tax card
taxCard.hint: Pay and what each rule took, month by month, from approved runs.
taxCard.emptyHint: The card fills as runs are approved.

returns.title: Returns
returns.emptyHint: Returns are listed once the run has statutory rules to report.

payment.title: Payment
payment.fileHint: Who to pay, how and how much, for the bank's bulk upload.
payment.audited: The payment list shows full account numbers. Every view and download is recorded in the audit log.
payment.sendHint: Email each employee their payslip, or text them a short notice with the net pay. Each payslip is sent once per channel.
payment.emailAsk: Email every employee their payslip? Payslips are personal, so check the email addresses first.
payment.smsAsk: Text every employee a notice with their net pay?
payment.sent: Queued {{queued}}. Already sent {{already}}. No contact details {{missing}}.

setup.title: Payroll setup
setup.hint: The taxes, contributions and levies that apply to your business, and the kinds of pay item.

rules.title: Statutory rules
rules.intro: Each rule is entered by you from the law or notice that applies to your business. A change is a new version from a later date, so past payroll can always be reproduced. Another person must verify every rule before a run can use it.
rules.verifyAsk: Check this rule against its source before verifying: {{source}}
rules.unverifiedWarning_one: {{count}} rule is not verified. A run that uses an unverified rule cannot be submitted.
rules.unverifiedWarning_other: {{count}} rules are not verified. A run that uses an unverified rule cannot be submitted.
rules.emptyHint: Add the taxes, contributions and levies that apply to your employees.
rules.deleteAsk: Delete {{name}} from {{date}}? This is only possible if no payslip used it.
rules.saved: Rule {{code}} saved. It must be verified by someone else before payroll can use it.
rules.saveInfo: The rule is saved unverified. A different person verifies it against the official notice.
rules.codeHint: Capital letters, digits or _. Used on returns and payslips.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.nameHint: As it should appear on payslips.
rules.sourceHint: The law or notice this comes from.
rules.effectiveToHint: Leave empty until a newer version replaces it.

baseHint.gross: Taxable cash pay for the period.
baseHint.taxable: Pay left after the earlier rules that reduce taxable pay.

rules.reduces: The employee's amount reduces taxable pay
rules.reducesHint: For rules that come first, such as a pension, so that later rules are charged on the lower amount.
rules.payableAccount: Account the amount is owed through
rules.payableAccountHint: A liability account in your books.
rules.employeeNone: The employee pays nothing under this rule.
rules.employerNone: The employer pays nothing under this rule.
rules.baseMaximumHint: Pay above this is not charged.
rules.minimumHint: The amount is never below this.
rules.maximumHint: The amount is never above this.
rules.bandsHint: Each band is charged at its own rate, up to its limit. The last band has no limit.
rules.creditHint: Taken off the tax worked out from the bands, never below zero.

baseSummary.taxable: taxable pay (pay after the earlier rules that reduce it)

summary.rate: {{who}} {{rate}} of the pay it is charged on.
summary.bands: {{who}} by bands, each charged at its own rate:
summary.baseMinimum: Nothing is due when the pay is under {{amount}}.
summary.baseMaximum: At most {{amount}} of pay is charged.
summary.credit: A fixed relief of {{amount}} is taken off the result (never below zero).
summary.reduces: The employee's amount is taken off taxable pay for the rules that follow.
summary.exempt: Employees marked exempt from this rule are skipped.

rules.tryItHint: An illustration to check the rule against the notice. Payroll always uses the server's own calculation.

problem.code: Use capital letters, digits or _, starting with a letter (up to 20).
problem.name: Give the rule a name.
problem.noParts: Choose what the employee pays, what the employer pays, or both.
problem.source: Say where the rule comes from (at least 3 characters).
problem.from: Choose the date the rule starts.
problem.range: The end date is before the start date.
problem.reduceTaxable: A rule charged on taxable pay cannot also reduce it.
problem.bandRate: Every band needs a rate between 0 and 100.
problem.bandOrder: Band limits must be filled in and increase.

widget.title: People and payroll
widget.unavailable: Could not load this just now.
widget.noLeave: No leave waiting for a decision.
